visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tortoiseshell cat lies on a white couch with pink cushions, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. (2) The camera pans left to reveal a circular wooden coffee table covered with various bags of Cheetos and several Ultraman action figures of different sizes and styles. (3) A rapid montage displays graphics of 13 different Ultraman collectible cards, each featuring a unique character design and specific name. (4) The scene shifts back to the living room where a man in a black t-shirt sits on the couch, holding a white bowl filled with corn snacks. He picks one up, showing it to the camera, and then takes a bite. (5) Close-ups follow of a red Cheetos bag (tomato flavor) and a yellow bag (seaweed flavor), highlighting the Ultraman artwork on the packaging. (6) The man stands behind the table, gesturing excitedly toward a large, highly detailed Ultraman statue on a rocky base, pointing out the battle-worn textures. (7) He then showcases a smaller articulated Ultraman figure, moving its limbs to demonstrate flexibility. (8) The video concludes with the man holding two large bags of snacks, smiling broadly, with the collection of toys and the cat in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male narrator introducing a sponsorship deal over a bright, synthesized electronic pop track with a steady 4/4 beat. (2) A subtle plastic rustling sound occurs as the narrator mentions product packaging. (3) The tempo remains consistent as he describes the collectible cards; short 'whoosh' sound effects accompany visual transitions. (4) A distinct 'crunch' sound is heard as the narrator bites into a snack, followed by an increase in vocal pitch variability as he expresses personal preference for the flavor. (5) As the narrator transitions to describing the prizes, his voice arousal peaks with loud, emphasized delivery; a metallic clicking sound is audible when showcasing figure articulation. (6) The music maintains energy throughout the closing call to action, ending with a final enthusiastic phrase and a quick fade-out of the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction of Collaboration -> Product Detail -> Prize Showcase -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a limited-edition collaboration between Cheetos Taiwan and the Ultraman franchise. It uses a high-energy, vlog-style delivery to inform viewers about new snack flavors, collectible cards found in packaging, and a lucky draw event with high-value statues and figures as prizes.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly mentions '工商' (sponsorship/business work) at the start and spends the entire video promoting Cheetos and the Ultraman collaboration raffle.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features a popular content creator (6tan) and his cat, leveraging personal brand appeal to drive engagement for the commercial promotion. The fast-paced editing and colorful graphics are typical of social media marketing for snack brands.
